features.title: Spec Review Engine
features.status: Implemented (retroactive specification of the first version)

features.title: Multi-tenant Backend
features.status: In progress (data layer, GitHub connection and review worker done; invitations pending)

features.title: Two Doors
features.status: Partially implemented (stories 1, 2, 3 and 5; the comparison of story 4 is not built)

intents.text: When the user runs the tool on a feature folder or a repository root, the system MUST locate spec.md, plan.md and tasks.md and parse them into requirements, user stories, plan items and tasks
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If spec.md cannot be found, then the system MUST exit with code 2 and a message that names the path searched
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a requirement has no counterpart in the plan or the tasks, the system MUST report a coverage gap with the requirement id and its file and line
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While the repository does not cite requirement ids in its plan or tasks, the system MUST report an inferred coverage gap with the warning severity
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a task or plan step introduces concepts that no requirement mentions, the system MUST report possible scope creep with its id and location
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a requirement uses a quality attribute without a numeric threshold, the system MUST report that the requirement is not testable
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When two requirements on the same topic state different values in the same unit, the system MUST report a contradiction as a blocker
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a user story has no acceptance scenarios, the system MUST report the story
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST NOT modify any file in the reviewed repository
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST print each finding on one line with its severity, location, rule and message
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where the user asks for another format, the system MUST print the same findings as JSON or as Markdown
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If any finding reaches the severity chosen with the fail-on option, then the system MUST exit with code 1
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While no model is configured, the system MUST NOT make any network request
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user asks to explain a rule, the system MUST print what it detects, why it matters and how to fix it
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: Where a model is configured, the system MUST send it only the requirements and tasks the text comparison could not resolve
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: On the example repository the tool reports every planted defect listed in expected.json and none of the forbidden findings
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Every rule the tool can emit has an entry in the rule catalog
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: A review of a feature with 17 requirements and 48 tasks completes in under 2 seconds
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: On the three implemented features of the real reference repository the tool reports 0 blockers
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user runs the tool with the all option on a repository root, the system MUST review every directory under specs/ that contains spec.md, in name order
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If no feature is found, then the system MUST exit with code 2 and a message that names the specs directory searched
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When every feature has been reviewed, the system MUST print a summary table with one row per feature showing its blocker, warning and suggestion counts
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While the path given is itself a feature folder, the system MUST review that single feature when the all option is present
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where the JSON format is chosen together with the all option, the system MUST print one document with a schema version and a list of the feature reports
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If any reviewed feature has a finding at or above the fail-on severity, then the system MUST exit with code 1
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If a feature cannot be parsed, then the system MUST report that feature as failed, continue with the remaining features and exit with code 2
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where the HTML format is chosen together with the all option, the system MUST exit with code 2 and explain that HTML export reviews one feature at a time
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where the min-severity option is present, the system MUST hide lower severities from each listing without changing the counts in the summary table
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While the all option is absent, the system MUST print exactly the output it printed before this feature existed
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Reviewing the four features of this repository with the all option completes in under 5 seconds
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: With the all option, the exit code equals the worst result among the features in 100% of the tested combinations
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the user sends a message, the system MUST stream the reply to the browser as the model produces it
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST give the model the findings of the review and the numbered text of the feature files as context
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While no model is configured, the system MUST report the assistant as unavailable and tell the user how to turn it on
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST NOT modify any file of the reviewed repository during a conversation
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If the model provider fails during a reply, then the system MUST show a readable error without any provider detail or credential
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the user asks about a finding, the system MUST open the assistant with the question written in the message box
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While a question the system wrote is in the message box, the system MUST wait for the user to send it
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: Where the demo provider is active, the system MUST state in the interface that the replies are examples and not from a model
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If a request comes from a host or an origin that is not the local machine, then the system MUST reject it
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a conversation exceeds 40 messages or a message exceeds 8000 characters, the system MUST keep only the latest 40 messages and cut each message to 8000 characters
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While the interface is open, the system MUST keep the conversation across tab switches
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user switches feature, the system MUST clear the conversation
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: With the demo provider, the first characters of a reply appear in the interface within 1 second of sending
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: In 100% of the tested conversations the hash of every file in the reviewed repository is the same before and after
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a user opens the interface for the first time, the system MUST show a dismissible introduction with four steps
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user has dismissed the introduction, the system MUST NOT show it on later visits
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user presses the help button, the system MUST open the introduction
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user expands a finding, the system MUST offer what its rule detects, why it matters and how to fix it
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST provide a guide page that explains what the product is, how it works, how to read a report and how far to trust it
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST list every rule of the catalog in the guide with what it detects and an example
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While the interface shows sample data, the system MUST say so and show the command that reviews the user's own repository
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If the server has no features or cannot be reached, then the system MUST show the commands that start the review instead of an error message
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: Where local storage is unavailable, the system MUST keep working
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: Where local storage is unavailable, the system MUST show the introduction on every visit
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST let the user operate the introduction with the keyboard alone
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: From the closing of the introduction, a user reaches the exact source line of any finding in at most 2 clicks
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: 100% of the rules the tool can emit appear in the guide
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a user opens the root page, the system MUST show an empty chat with suggested prompts and a message box as the whole page
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user sends a message on the root page, the system MUST show the conversation with the message box at the bottom
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user asks the agent to review a feature, the system MUST answer with a review card that shows the count of findings per severity and the most serious findings
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While the user is on a page other than the root page, the system MUST show the agent in a side panel on the right
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user collapses the side panel, the system MUST keep the conversation and show a button that reopens the panel
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While the user is on the page of a feature, the system MUST show that feature as the context of the agent
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST keep one conversation shared by the root page and the side panel
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST show a sidebar with the main sections that the user can collapse to icons
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user opens the tenant switcher, the system MUST list the workspaces of the user and switch to the one the user chooses
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user opens the user menu, the system MUST offer profile, language, theme, documentation, help and log out
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user chooses log out, the system MUST show a signed-out screen from which the user can sign in again
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user opens the notifications, the system MUST list recent events and mark them as read
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user presses the command palette shortcut, the system MUST open a palette that searches pages, features and rules
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: Where a page shows simulated data, the system MUST label it as demo data
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user switches the language, the system MUST show the texts of the shell and of the new pages in that language
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user opens the address of an inner page directly, the system MUST show that page
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST build into static files that run on Vercel without a server of ours
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While no backend can be reached, the system MUST answer with a simulated agent and state that the answers are examples
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While a backend with a model can be reached, the system MUST use that model for the conversation
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST let the user reach and use the sidebar, the menus, the palette and the side panel with the keyboard alone
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: From the root page, a visitor gets a review card in at most 2 interactions
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The JavaScript needed to show the first view of any page, before the first interaction and without the prefetch that runs later when the browser is idle, is at most 250 KB gzipped
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: In 100% of the tested inner pages, opening the address directly shows that page
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the review runs with a base reference, the system MUST review only the features that changed against that base
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the review runs in the pull request workflow, the system MUST publish its findings as annotations in the diff
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the review runs again on the same pull request, the system MUST update its earlier comment instead of adding another
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user records the current findings, the system MUST stop reporting those findings on later runs
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST identify a finding by its feature, rule, ids and file and MUST NOT use its line number
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the user records a finding with a reason, the system MUST silence it and MUST store the reason, the author and the date
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If a recorded exception has an expiry date that has passed, the system MUST report the finding again
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the user asks to prepare a repository, the system MUST write a configuration file and a workflow and MUST NOT overwrite existing files
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: A repository with existing findings gets a first pull request review that reports 0 old findings after the recording step
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the agent asks for the blockers of a feature, the system MUST return the blockers and whether the feature can be implemented
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST apply the configuration, the baseline and the waivers of the repository to every answer
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the agent asks to check a requirement text, the system MUST return its EARS pattern and its issues
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the user asks to implement a feature that has blockers, the system MUST stop the request and show the blockers
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If the repository is not a Spec Kit project, the system MUST NOT stop any request
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST answer over standard input and output without any runtime dependency
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: A client completes the handshake and gets the blockers of a feature in at most 2 requests
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a feature has findings that only the approver can resolve, the system MUST show the verdict that it needs the decision of the approver
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a feature has blockers and none of them needs the approver, the system MUST show the verdict that it is blocked
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST NOT show rule ids in the executive summary or in the list of decisions
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the decisions page opens, the system MUST list the findings that the approver can resolve, grouped by feature
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While decisions are pending, the system MUST show their number in the sidebar
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the user copies the summary, the system MUST put a plain text version on the clipboard
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: In 100% of the sample reviews, the page shows the same verdict as the report
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a spec cites a decision that is superseded or rejected, the system MUST report a blocker that names the decision
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a requirement uses a term that an accepted decision rules out, the system MUST report a warning that names the requirement and the decision
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where the repository defines goals, the system MUST report a warning for a spec that declares no goal
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the goal report runs, the system MUST list every goal that no feature cites
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a spec cites a goal or a decision that does not exist, the system MUST report a warning that names it
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where the repository has no product folder, the system MUST NOT report any product finding
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: In 100% of the tested repositories without a product folder, the review output is identical to the output before this layer
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When an approver records a decision, the system MUST store who decided, when, which decision and the hash of the spec files
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While a spec file differs from the version that was decided on, the system MUST show the decision as stale and name the changed files
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST link each record to the previous one so that an edit or a deletion is detected, and MUST refuse to append to a broken log
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If a feature has blockers, the system MUST refuse to approve it unless the approver gives an override and a reason
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If the person is not an approver, the system MUST refuse to record a decision
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a signed Slack click arrives from a user linked to an approver, the system MUST record the decision, and the system MUST reject a click with an invalid or expired signature
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the user asks for a Jira sync, the system MUST write the issues to a cache file, and a review MUST NOT call the network
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: In 100% of tested edits or deletions of a past record, the verification names the first broken entry
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While the person has not asked for more, the system MUST show at most three entries in the sidebar and a control that shows the rest
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a review opens, the system MUST show the executive summary first and MUST keep the technical findings collapsed
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the decisions page opens, the system MUST show what waits for the approver first and MUST keep the goals, the history and the list of all features collapsed
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While a section is collapsed, the system MUST show in its heading how many items it holds
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the person opens or closes a section with the mouse or the keyboard, the system MUST do it in place and MUST state whether the section is expanded
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the address points to a finding, the system MUST open the section that holds it
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST let the person reach every page through the command palette, whether or not the sidebar lists it
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the person opens a section or the extra navigation, the system MUST remember that choice for the next visit
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: Where the page is an exported report, the system MUST show the technical findings open
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: On a first visit, the sidebar shows at most 3 links and the review page shows 0 finding rows until the person asks for them
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: In 100% of the pages of the product, every section that is collapsed by default opens with at most 1 interaction
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a person signs in for the first time, the system MUST show a checklist with four milestones instead of the text-only introduction
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the person completes the action of a milestone in the product, the system MUST mark that milestone as done without a manual action
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST include a sample feature with one open decision between two rules that contradict each other and MUST label it as a sample
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the person opens the help menu, the system MUST offer to reopen the checklist and MUST show which milestones are done
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the person sends a business need in plain language, the system MUST show a draft spec whose open questions are listed as decisions
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST NOT write the draft to the repository until the person confirms
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: Where no model is configured, the system MUST offer a spec template with the questions to answer
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the person picks a repository, the system MUST run the first review and show its executive summary
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If the repository has no specs, then the system MUST offer to start from a business need
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While a page is for people who approve, the system MUST say decision instead of finding and intent instead of requirement and MUST keep the technical terms inside the technical detail
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a page has nothing to show, the system MUST say what is already decided and what the person can do next
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the weekly digest is sent, the system MUST summarize the decisions waiting, the features ready to build and the decisions recorded
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST NOT add a new element to every page to repeat the thesis
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: Where the browser blocks storage, the system MUST still show the checklist and MUST work without remembering its progress
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The checklist MUST be usable with the keyboard and MUST announce the state of each milestone
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: A new person completes the third milestone in at most 5 minutes and at most 12 interactions, typing only one short reason
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: After signing in, the first executive summary is reachable in at most 3 interactions
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: Pages for people who approve contain 0 uses of the words finding and requirement outside the technical detail
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The thesis adds 0 permanent elements to the pages of the product beyond the checklist (NFR-001)
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a signed-in person creates a company, the system MUST make them its owner
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST show a person only the data of the companies they belong to
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While a person's role is viewer or member, the system MUST refuse the decisions they try to record
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a decision is recorded, the system MUST chain it by hash to the previous decision of the company
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST refuse any edit or deletion of a recorded decision
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If a decision is anything but a plain approval, then the system MUST require a reason
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If a change would leave a company without an owner, then the system MUST refuse it
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the verification runs, the system MUST report the first decision whose hash does not match
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST store every installation, repository, feature, spec version and review under exactly one company
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When GitHub delivers the same webhook twice, the system MUST process it once
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST keep stored webhook payloads unreadable to signed-in people
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When an owner or an admin connects GitHub, the system MUST store the installation and its repositories under their company
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If an installation is already linked to a company, then the system MUST refuse to link it to another one
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If a webhook request does not carry a valid GitHub signature, then the system MUST refuse it and store nothing
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a push to the default branch changes files under specs, the system MUST queue one pending job for that repository
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a queued push is processed, the system MUST store each feature version and its review under the company of the repository
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If the specs of a commit have the same content as a stored version, then the system MUST NOT store that version again
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST read only the Spec Kit files and the product files of a repository, within fixed limits of size and count
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If reading a repository fails, then the system MUST retry the job later with growing delays up to five attempts
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a person is not signed in with a valid token, the system MUST refuse their requests to the API
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST enforce company isolation inside the database and not only in the application
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST run its own database work with the least privilege that work needs
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: For every table that holds company data, a member of company A reads 0 rows of company B and an anonymous visitor reads 0 rows (NFR-001)
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: After one decision is altered directly in the database, the verification fails and names that decision's position
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The stored hash of a feature version equals the hash the command line uses for approvals, so a decision recorded in either place points at the same version
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: A webhook delivered twice, or retried after a failure, changes the data exactly once
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a repository finishes its first sync, the system MUST store an inventory of its files by kind
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a repository has specs marked as implemented, the system MUST propose a rule for each of their requirements
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where the company consented to code analysis of a repository, the system MUST propose the rules it finds in that code
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While the company has not consented to code analysis of a repository, the system MUST keep that repository's code away from any model
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If the lines quoted as evidence of a proposed rule are not in the repository at that commit, then the system MUST discard the proposal
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST keep every rule it proposes as proposed until a person decides
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When an approver confirms, corrects or rejects a rule, the system MUST record who, when and what changed in a record that cannot be altered
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While a person's role is viewer or member, the system MUST refuse their decisions on rules
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When an owner or an approver freezes the baseline, the system MUST store the confirmed rules as a snapshot that cannot be altered, with a hash of the whole
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a new commit changes or removes the supporting lines of a confirmed rule, the system MUST open a finding that names the rule
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When an approver acknowledges a finding, the system MUST record who and why
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If a rule is proposed that already exists for the repository, then the system MUST NOT create a second one
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST send code to a model only for repositories with consent and only the files selected within a fixed budget
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: 100% of the stored proposals have at least one evidence whose quoted lines were found in the repository at that commit
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Changing any rule inside a frozen baseline is refused, and the baseline hash differs for any different set of confirmed rules
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: A change to the supporting lines of a confirmed rule opens a finding on the next sync of that repository
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where the app is configured for the cloud and nobody is signed in, the system MUST offer to sign in with GitHub or with an email link
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If a signed-in person has no company, then the system MUST ask them to create one before showing anything else
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST list in the workspace switcher the companies the service reports for the signed-in person
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a person signs out, the system MUST forget the session
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If the service refuses the session as invalid, then the system MUST sign the person out
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When an owner or an admin connects GitHub, the system MUST send them to GitHub to install the App for their company
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While a person's role is viewer or member, the system MUST NOT let them start the GitHub connection
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When the person returns from GitHub, the system MUST list the repositories connected to the company
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a person asks for the portrait of a repository, the system MUST queue the request and show the portrait
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: Where the app is configured for the cloud, the system MUST show the company's rules from the service and not the demo's
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a person decides a rule, freezes a baseline or acknowledges a change, the system MUST send it to the service and show the stored result
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If the service refuses a decision, then the system MUST tell the person why
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When an owner changes the permission to analyze a repository's code, the system MUST send it to the service
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: Where no cloud is configured, the system MUST NOT contact any service
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST NOT load the sign-in library in an app built without cloud settings
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If the access token was issued to an AI agent, then the system MUST refuse any decision
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If the files of the version changed since the person opened it, then the system MUST record nothing
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a pull request changes a spec of a repository the company reads, the system MUST keep the version it proposes and link the comment to deciding it
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: While a version proposed by a pull request waits for a decision, the system MUST show a check named «Speco · decisión» as action required
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a person decides a version a pull request proposes, the system MUST update the check and the comment to the outcome: success when approved and failure when rejected
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a pull request receives a new push, the system MUST open a new pending check for the new version
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If the company does not read the repository of a pull request, then the system MUST post the comment and no check
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST NOT name the person or repeat their reason in a comment or a check
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If GitHub refuses the check, then the system MUST still post the comment
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: When a link names a company the person belongs to, the system MUST open that company
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: If a link names a company the person does not belong to, then the system MUST ignore it
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: A member of a company that read a repository sees only that repository's features on the decisions page in 100 % of the checks
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: A decision recorded in the app reaches the pull request's check within 5 seconds in the browser check
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: 0 decisions are recorded from a viewer or an agent token
intents.label: construida sin test

intents.text: The system MUST list every requirement and success criterion of every feature once, with exactly one state among proposed, decided, built, covered, verified and failing
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a feature is implemented and a test cites one of its requirements by feature and id, the system MUST mark that requirement as covered, and as built when no test cites it
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST show each citation with its file and line, and MUST tell citations in tests from citations in code
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a citation names a feature or a requirement that does not exist, the system MUST list it as orphan evidence
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the agent asks what the software does today, the system MUST list only the built, covered, verified and failing requirements, grouped by feature
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the repository configures a verification command and the agent verifies a requirement, the system MUST run only the tests that cite it and MUST record the outcome, the command, the commit and the hash of the requirement text
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST keep the verification runs and the intent changes in append-only records chained by hash, and MUST report the first entry that breaks the chain
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the latest run for the current text of a requirement passed, the system MUST mark it verified, when it failed it MUST mark it failing, and runs recorded for an earlier text MUST NOT count
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When no verification command is configured, the system MUST NOT run anything and MUST say which setting to add
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the agent drafts a feature, the system MUST write one spec in Draft status under the next free feature number, MUST write no other file, and MUST return its path and its review
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the agent changes or adds a requirement, the system MUST write only that spec file and MUST return the text before and after, the values that moved and the findings about that requirement
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a change touches a feature approved for its current version, the system MUST say that the approval no longer covers the spec, and MUST NOT record any approval
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the agent drafts a feature or changes a requirement, the system MUST append to the intent record who made it, when, the text before and after and the reason given
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When someone asks for the history of a requirement, the system MUST list every version of its text in the git history of its spec, oldest first, with commit, author, date and kind of change
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST place the approvals of the feature, the intent changes and the verification runs of the requirement in the same timeline as its versions
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the repository has no git history, the system MUST show the current version and say that the history is not available
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The ledger command MUST print the counts by state and every requirement as text, JSON or Markdown
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the strict flag is given and a built requirement has no test or a requirement is failing, the ledger command MUST exit with 1
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The web app MUST offer a page with the counts by state and the requirements of each feature with their state and evidence
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The MCP server MUST tell a connected agent to read the ledger before reading code and to write new or corrected rules in the specs through its tools
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The ledger of a repository with 30 features and 500 source files is built in under 5 seconds without a verification run
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: On this repository, every requirement of this feature is covered or verified by its own tests
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where the repository binds a rule to a line of code in specreview.toml with a file and a pattern that captures one number, the system MUST read that number every time it builds the ledger, without running any test
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the number a bound line holds is not one of the numbers the rule states, the system MUST mark the rule as failing and show the number the rule states, the number the code holds, and the file and line
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a bound number differs from the rule, the system MUST name the commit, the author and the date that last changed that line
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If the bound file does not exist or the pattern matches nothing, then the system MUST report the binding as broken
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While a binding of a rule is broken, the system MUST NOT report the rule as verified
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a change to a requirement moves a number, the system MUST list the bindings that still hold the old number and the other rules of the same feature that state a number in the same unit
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the latest verification of a rule ran on a commit other than the current one, the system MUST say how many commits ago it ran
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: With the referral monthly cap raised to 25 in the code and the spec still saying 10, the ledger reports 021/FR-008 as failing with the commit that raised it, in under 5 seconds and without running tests
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Three builds of the ledger on the same commit report the same bound values
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a verification run ends without running any test, the system MUST record it as an error with its output
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While the latest run of a rule is an error, the system MUST keep the state that the previous runs of that rule give it
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a JUnit report is imported and every test that cites a rule passed in it, the system MUST record that rule as verified on the current commit
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a JUnit report is imported and a test that cites a rule failed in it, the system MUST record that rule as failing
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: If none of the tests that cite a rule appear in an imported report, then the system MUST NOT record a run for that rule
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where the repository configures a suite command with a placeholder for the report, the system MUST run the suite once and import its report to verify every rule
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When an imported report breaks a rule, the system MUST print that rule with its text and MUST exit with code 1
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When bindings are suggested, the system MUST propose for each rule that states a number the lines of code that hold that number next to an identifier sharing a word with the rule, as TOML, without writing any file
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST propose a binding only when the first match of its pattern in the file is the proposed line
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: On this repository the suggestions include the bindings of 021/FR-005, 021/FR-008, 021/FR-009 and 021/FR-013 that a person wrote
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Importing a JUnit report of 700 tests takes under 5 seconds
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where a decision states the numbers it fixes as <feature>/<id> = <number>, the system MUST read them as part of the decision
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a rule fixed by an accepted decision does not state the number the decision fixes, the system MUST report a blocker that names the decision, its number and the rule
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a bound line of code breaks a rule fixed by a decision, the system MUST name that decision in the reason
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a change to a requirement moves a number that an accepted decision fixes, the system MUST list that decision and say that a person has to decide again
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a pull request in a repository a company reads moves a decided number in the code, the system MUST keep the check «Speco · decisión» pending until a person decides that version of the feature
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a person opens the version a pull request proposes, the system MUST show each decided number the pull request moves, the number the rule states and the file and line
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: On this repository, D-015 states the referral numbers and the review of 021 reports 0 findings about them
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: A pull request that raises the referral cap in the code leaves the check pending in 100% of the runs of the bridge test
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a verification run is recorded, the system MUST record a fingerprint of the source of each test that cites the rule
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the source of a test that cites a rule differs from the fingerprint recorded in the latest run of that rule, the system MUST treat that run as stale and show the rule as covered
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a run of a rule no longer counts because its tests changed, the system MUST name each test that changed
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a test cites a rule and the latest run of that rule has fingerprints but none for that test, the system MUST treat that run as stale and show the rule as covered
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While a run has no recorded fingerprints, the system MUST count it as it did before this feature existed
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a change against a base branch modifies a test that cites a rule, the system MUST list that rule and that test in the review of the change
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When a test that cites a rule uses a property-based testing library, the system MUST label the evidence of that rule as generated cases, and as examples otherwise
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The system MUST NOT label the evidence of any rule as proved
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the person asks for the shape of the rules, the system MUST classify each functional requirement as invariant, conditional or not formalizable
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: When the shape of the rules is printed, the system MUST show the count and the percentage of each class with the total
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Where the repository opts in to test review in its specreview.toml, the system MUST list in the pull request comment each rule whose citing test the pull request edits
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: While a repository has not opted in to test review, the system MUST NOT read any test file of its pull requests
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: The ledger of this repository, with fingerprints, is built in under 5 seconds
intents.label: verificada

intents.text: Editing the body of a test that verifies a rule turns that rule from verified to covered in 100% of the tested cases
intents.label: verificada
